content.short: Jivo Pets is a Telegram Web3 game about raising virtual pets with MMO-style progression.
content.description: Jivo Pets is a Telegram Mini App game that combines virtual pet care with MMO-inspired mechanics. Its official materials describe hatching and raising magical pets, crafting, guilds, resource gathering, PvP battles, and blockchain ownership through TON and NFTs. The game is designed to make Web3 gameplay approachable from inside Telegram. Users approach it as an interactive game first, with Web3 mechanics layered into rewards, ownership, or community participation. Jivo Pets is kept in this TON set because its product has a concrete user or builder workflow, not only a loose mention of the network.
